races.display_title: Lisburn And Castlereagh City Council 3-Y-O Hurdle
races.verdict: KENOUGH can build on his promising hurdle debut third at Punchestown and prove too strong for penalised Killarney winner Cite Florale . Gordon Elliott's Contador was well behind the selection at Punchestown but should improve and get closer to him this time. KENOUGH (FR) CITE FLORALE (FR) CONTADOR

races.display_title: Kildress Plumbing Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict: RADIATOR SPRINGS again shaped like a very well-treated mare when fourth of 18 at Listowel on her return last month and gets the nod to confirm the promise of that run faced with a seemingly ideal test. The selection's stablemate Lieber Nicc hasn't been seen since winning this race last year, but that is no bad thing given he's plainly very capable fresh and must be taken seriously in his bid to repeat the feat from a 10 lb higher mark. Ben Hur remains unexposed and completes the shortlist. RADIATOR SPRINGS (IRE) LIEBER NICC (IRE) BEN HUR (IRE)

races.display_title: SIS, Proud Sponsors Of Irish Racing (Pro/Am) Flat Race
races.verdict: UNCLE PAD makes obvious appeal having been purchased by top connections for £310,000 after easily winning his sole outing in points, so he's put forward as the answer. Bravemans Call was much improved from his debut when runner-up to a well-touted Mullins newcomer at Listowel last month and is clear pick of those with experience. Malpaso is out of a bumper winner and any market support for him would be worth noting. UNCLE PAD (IRE) BRAVEMANS CALL (IRE) MALPASO (IRE)

races.display_title: Ascot Underwriting Novices' Limited Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict: JET TO VEGAS has been lightly raced in recent seasons and bounced right back to his best following 4 months off when defeating a next-time-out winner at Market Rasen 5 weeks ago. His very best form over fences has come in small fields and he could well be worthy of siding with to follow up. Dance And Glance and Glynn Brae are 2 interesting chase debutants, though, whilst The Gray Ghost appeals as the type to come forward from his Uttoxeter chase debut second. JET TO VEGAS (IRE) DANCE AND GLANCE THE GRAY GHOST (IRE)

races.display_title: Sodexo Live! Regal Encore Handicap Chase (Premier Handicap) (GBB Race)
races.verdict: An open-looking renewal in which it could pay to side with the hat-trick seeking TAPLEY . He's thrived upon joining the Moore stable under this rider in recent weeks and with the return to further unlikely to be an issue, particularly on a right-handed track, he could well put his fitness edge over the majority to very good use. Califet en Vol , Viroflay and last year's winner Henry's Friend head the dangers, with Transmission also worth a look in a change of headgear. TAPLEY CALIFET EN VOL (IRE) VIROFLAY (FR)
races.betting_forecast: Viroflay (10/3), Califet En Vol (7/2), Henry's Friend (7/1), Queensbury Boy (7/1), Your Darling (8/1), Neon Moon (10/1), Tapley (10/1), Transmission (12/1), Imperial Alex (14/1), Somespring Special (14/1)

races.verdict: Penalised pair LORD CHURCHILL and Saint Argente make most appeal. The latter impressed in coming from last to first at Warwick but the former accounted for a next-time-out winner in a good time on his debut at Wincanton and edges the vote. Colombe D'or is a well-bred newcomer from a yard in excellent order and would have to enter calculations if supported in the betting. LORD CHURCHILL (IRE) SAINT ARGENTE (IRE) COLOMBE D'OR (FR)

races.verdict: A useful handicap which seems sure to make for strong form. PRINCLING shaped encouragingly back down in trip after 3 months off (gelded since in interim) when third in a minor event at Ascot last time and looks on a good mark now returning to handicap company. Fellow 3-y-o Portcullis won both his starts back in the spring and remains open to significant improvement, while there could easily be more to come from Murashah , who's 2 from 2 for Ed Bethell. PRINCLING PORTCULLIS MURASHAH (IRE)

races.verdict: A useful handicap. BEAGLE BAY let favourite backers down at York earlier in the month but is probably worth another chance given how well his Sandown defeat of Raammee in June has worked out. Returning Gosden stable handicap newcomer Lighting Thunder brings obvious unexposed potential. Charlie Appleby pair Man of Vision and Fort Rock are also 3-y-os with positive profiles, while River King scored in good style at Doncaster last weekend. BEAGLE BAY (FR) LIGHTING THUNDER MAN OF VISION
